sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为无名女尸（Jane Doe）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈现”（Casefile Presents）的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: Eduard Trudy lived in the Czech Republic town of Kourim.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·特鲁迪（Eduard Trudy）住在捷克共和国的库日姆（Kourim）镇。

sentences.en: On Monday, May 7, 2007, Eduard was home alone making some last-minute preparations.
sentences.zh: 2007年5月7日，星期一，爱德华独自在家做着最后的准备工作。

sentences.en: His partner had recently given birth, and Eduard was trying to set up a baby monitor before she and their baby daughter were discharged from hospital.
sentences.zh: 他的伴侣最近刚生完孩子，爱德华正试图在她和女儿出院前安装好婴儿监视器。

sentences.en: At around 11am, Eduard connected the device to his television.
sentences.zh: 大约上午11点，爱德华将设备连接到了电视上。

sentences.en: He scanned the channel selector, waiting for the live feed from the monitor's video camera to show on the screen.
sentences.zh: 他扫描着频道选择器，等待监视器摄像头的实时画面显示在屏幕上。

sentences.en: An image did appear, but it wasn't coming from inside Eduard's home.
sentences.zh: 画面确实出现了，但并不是来自爱德华家内部。

sentences.en: The baby monitor had intercepted another camera's signal.
sentences.zh: 这个婴儿监视器截获了另一个摄像头的信号。

sentences.en: The black and white feed on the television showed a young boy who Eduard didn't know.
sentences.zh: 电视上的黑白画面显示了一个爱德华不认识的小男孩。

sentences.en: He appeared content as he sat naked on a concrete floor playing with a roll of duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他光着身子坐在一处混凝土水泥地上，正玩着一卷强力胶带，看起来挺满足的。

sentences.en: Believing the baby monitor had a technical fault, Eduard set it aside and carried on with his day.
sentences.zh: 爱德华以为婴儿监视器出了技术故障，便把它放在一边，继续过他的一天。

sentences.en: He returned to it later to try again, but it intercepted the same feed from earlier.
sentences.zh: 他后来又回去想再试一次，但截获的还是先前的那个画面。

sentences.en: This time, the naked boy was being fed torn pieces of bread by a woman whose face was out of view.
sentences.zh: 这一次，那个赤裸的男孩正被一个看不见脸的女人喂着撕碎的面包。

sentences.en: Eduard heard her say, here you go, but didn't recognise her voice.
sentences.zh: 爱德华听到她说“给你”，但他听不出这是谁的声音。

sentences.en: It dawned on Eduard that the boy's hands were tied behind his back.
sentences.zh: 爱德华突然意识到，这个男孩的双手被反绑在身后。

sentences.en: Eduard told his partner what he'd seen and they decided that they should notify the authorities.
sentences.zh: 爱德华把他的所见告诉了伴侣，他们决定应该报警。

sentences.en: Before doing so, Eduard switched on the baby monitor and TV to assess the situation one last time.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，爱德华打开了婴儿监视器和电视，最后一次评估情况。

sentences.en: This time, the boy was clearly hogtied and licking what appeared to be vomit from the floor.
sentences.zh: 这一次，男孩被明显地五花大绑，正在舔舐地上类似呕吐物的东西。

sentences.en: In the summer of 2005, 28-year-old Clara Mauarova was working at a youth centre in the Czech city of Brøne.
sentences.zh: 在2005年的夏天，28岁的克拉拉·毛拉罗娃（Clara Mauarova）在捷克城市布尔诺（Brno）的一个青年中心工作。

sentences.en: The centre was run by her older sister, Katerina, who approached Clara one day to discuss a child who had just arrived from Norway.
sentences.zh: 该中心由她的姐姐卡特琳娜（Katerina）运营，一天，卡特琳娜找到克拉拉，商讨一个刚从挪威来的孩子的事。

sentences.en: Her name was Anichka.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫阿尼奇卡（Anichka）。

sentences.en: She was around 12 years old, sickly, and in need of special foster care.
sentences.zh: 她大约12岁，体弱多病，需要特殊的寄养护理。

sentences.en: Katerina believed her sister would make an ideal foster mother for the girl.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜认为她的妹妹会成为这个女孩理想的养母。

sentences.en: It wasn't an unusual thought.
sentences.zh: 这个想法并不寻常。

sentences.en: Clara Mauarova was successfully raising her sons, 7-year-old Jakub and 5-year-old Andre, as a single mother.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉·毛拉罗娃作为单亲母亲，成功地抚养着她的两个儿子：7岁的雅库布（Jakub）和5岁的安德烈（Andre）。

sentences.en: The boys attended the same youth centre where their mother worked, participating in games, sporting activities, and language studies.
sentences.zh: 男孩们和他们的母亲在同一个青年中心，参加游戏、体育活动和语言学习。

sentences.en: Energetic and sporty, Andre loved hockey.
sentences.zh: 安德烈精力充沛、热爱运动，十分喜欢曲棍球。

sentences.en: His older brother, Jakub, played basketball as well as the flute.
sentences.zh: 他的哥哥雅库布则打篮球，还会吹长笛。

sentences.en: He was an avid reader who was especially fond of dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 他是一个狂热的阅读爱好者，尤其喜欢恐龙。

sentences.en: Clara's other sister, Gabriella, spent time with the family at least twice a week.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉的另一个姐姐加布里埃拉（Gabriella）每周至少有两天时间和这个家庭在一起。

sentences.en: She described her nephews as sweethearts, and Clara as a great mother and a role model.
sentences.zh: 她形容她的外甥们是小甜心，而克拉拉则是一位伟大的母亲和榜样。

sentences.en: Working at the youth centre had fostered Clara's interest in child education, and she was in the process of gaining professional teaching qualifications.
sentences.zh: 在青年中心的工作培养了克拉拉对儿童教育的兴趣，她当时正在攻读专业教师资格证。

sentences.en: Balancing studies with everyday life wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 平衡学业与日常生活并不容易。

sentences.en: Jakub and Andre often had to accompany their mother on her class field trips.
sentences.zh: 雅库布和安德烈经常得陪着母亲去参加班级的实地考察。

sentences.en: They'd also hang around campus, quietly entertaining themselves while Clara completed her assignments.
sentences.zh: 他们也会在校园里闲逛，安安静静地自己玩耍，同时等待克拉拉完成作业。

sentences.en: It was chaotic, but life was good, and the boys were happy.
sentences.zh: 生活虽然有些混乱，但很美好，男孩们也很高兴。

sentences.en: Clara's university supervisor, who had met Jakub and Andre many times, noted that Clara was raising her boys beautifully.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉的大学导师曾多次见过雅库布和安德烈，他指出克拉拉把孩子们抚养得极好。

sentences.en: After Clara's sister told her about Anichka, Clara went to meet the girl.
sentences.zh: 在克拉拉的姐姐告诉她关于阿尼奇卡的事后，克拉拉便去见了那个女孩。

sentences.en: She found her painting in the woods by the youth centre.
sentences.zh: 她发现她在青年中心附近的树林里画画。

sentences.en: Anichka was short and very thin, with mousy brown hair and glasses.
sentences.zh: 阿尼奇卡个子很矮，非常瘦，留着鼠灰色棕发，戴着眼镜。

sentences.en: She spoke quietly and nervously in a mixture of Czech and Norwegian.
sentences.zh: 她用捷克语和挪威语夹杂着，安静而紧张地说话。

sentences.en: While she didn't reveal much about herself, Clara could tell that the girl was severely traumatised.
sentences.zh: 虽然她没有透露太多关于自己的事，但克拉拉能看出这个女孩受过严重的创伤。

sentences.en: Clara spent the next few weeks building a rapport with Anichka, who eventually opened up about her paSt.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，克拉拉花时间与阿尼奇卡建立关系，后者最终敞开心扉谈及了自己的过去。

sentences.en: Following the death of her parents, Anichka was placed in an orphanage where she was mistreated by those who ran the facility.
sentences.zh: 父母去世后，阿尼奇卡被送进了一家孤儿院，在那里她遭到该机构管理人员的虐待。

sentences.en: Eventually, Anichka, along with some other children, had been sold into a pedophile ring and endured horrendous acts of sexual abuse and torture.
sentences.zh: 最终，阿尼奇卡和其他一些孩子一起被卖给了一个恋童癖团伙，经受了惨绝人寰的性虐待和折磨。

sentences.en: She had also been forced to participate in the torture of the other children.
sentences.zh: 她还被迫参与折磨其他孩子。

sentences.en: When the pedophile ring was finally exposed, Anichka was sent to Katerina Maurova's Centre for Children, as she had no parents or guardians to claim her.
sentences.zh: 当恋童癖团伙最终败露时，由于没有父母或监护人来认领她，阿尼奇卡被送到了卡特琳娜·毛拉罗娃的儿童中心。

sentences.en: Anichka was being treated by Andrei Zainalov, a psychiatric doctor from Azerbaijan who specialised in helping children with traumatic histories.
sentences.zh: 阿尼奇卡正接受安德烈·扎伊纳洛夫（Andrei Zainalov）的治疗，他是一名来自阿塞拜疆的精神科医生，专门帮助有创伤历史的儿童。

sentences.en: He allowed Clara to take a look at Anichka's medical file.
sentences.zh: 他允许克拉拉查看阿尼奇卡的医疗档案。

sentences.en: Dr Zainalov explained that in addition to her psychological traumas, Anichka also had leukaemia.
sentences.zh: 扎伊纳洛夫医生解释说，除了心理创伤之外，阿尼奇卡还患有白血病。

sentences.en: In his opinion, she would be lucky if she lived to the age of 16.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，她能活到16岁就已经很幸运了。

sentences.en: From around September 2005, Anichka began living with Clara full-time.
sentences.zh: 大约从2005年9月起，阿尼奇卡开始和克拉拉全职生活在一起。

sentences.en: As part of this new arrangement, Clara's sister, Katerina, took Anichka to the hospital for chemotherapy sessions.
sentences.zh: 作为这一新安排的一部分，克拉拉的姐姐卡特琳娜带着阿尼奇卡去医院进行化疗。

sentences.en: Dr Zainalov continued to treat Anichka remotely, sending therapy and care instructions to Clara via email and text messages.
sentences.zh: 扎伊纳洛夫医生继续远程治疗阿尼奇卡，通过电子邮件和短信向克拉拉发送治疗和护理说明。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Clara wanted to formally adopt Anichka.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，克拉拉就想正式收养阿尼奇卡。

sentences.en: Twelve months later, in October 2006, Clara and Katerina Maurova sat in the office of Brunez Deputy Ombudsman.
sentences.zh: 十二个月后的2006年10月，克拉拉和卡特琳娜·毛拉罗娃坐在布尔诺副申诉专员的办公室里。

sentences.en: Katerina had used her standing as the director of a youth centre to arrange the meeting.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳娜利用她作为青年中心主任的身份安排了这次会面。

sentences.en: The sisters explained that they had spent the previous year doing everything they could to have Anichka adopted by Clara.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩解释说，过去一年里她们一直在尽一切努力让克拉拉收养阿尼奇卡。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, their efforts were hindered due to the fact that Anichka didn't possess a birth certificate or passport.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于阿尼奇卡没有出生证明或护照，她们的努力受到了阻碍。

sentences.en: Without legal identification, it was almost impossible for Clara to adopt Anichka.
sentences.zh: 没有法律身份证明，克拉拉几乎不可能收养阿尼奇卡。

sentences.en: The sisters had approached multiple institutions seeking help, but no one was willing or able to assist them.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩曾向多家机构寻求帮助，但没有人愿意或能够协助她们。

sentences.en: One was the Endangered Children Fund, a non-government, non-profit organisation that provided social and legal protection to children in the Czech Republic.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是濒危儿童基金会（Endangered Children Fund），这是一个非政府、非营利组织，为捷克共和国的儿童提供社会和法律保护。

sentences.en: In order to receive their help, Anichka needed to stay at the Fund's children's shelter while her case progressed.
sentences.zh: 为了获得他们的帮助，阿尼奇卡需要在基金会的儿童收容所暂住，直到她的案件取得进展。

sentences.en: Given Anichka's traumatic history and ill health, Clara and Katerina expressed their concern that such an upheaval could have devastating effects.
sentences.zh: 鉴于阿尼奇卡创伤深重的过去和不良的健康状况，克拉拉和卡特琳娜表达了他们的担忧，认为这种剧变可能会带来毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: From a procedural standpoint, the Deputy Ombudsman should have referred Anichka's case to departmental social workers.
sentences.zh: 从程序的角度来看，副申诉专员本应将阿尼奇卡的案件移交部门社会工作者。

sentences.en: However, she agreed that removing Anichka from her foster family was not in her best interests.
sentences.zh: 然而，她同意将阿尼奇卡从寄养家庭带走并不符合她的最佳利益。

sentences.en: The Deputy Ombudsman provided the Maurova sisters with advice on how to proceed.
sentences.zh: 副申诉专员向毛拉罗娃姐妹提供了如何进行下一步的建议。

sentences.en: The first step was for Anichka's age to be verified.
sentences.zh: 第一步是核实阿尼奇卡的年龄。

sentences.en: Over the course of several weeks, Katerina accompanied Anichka to University Hospital in Brunei, where she was subjected to various medical examinations.
sentences.zh: 在几周的时间里，卡特琳娜陪同阿尼奇卡前往布尔诺大学医院，在那里她接受了各种医学检查。

sentences.en: X-rays of her forearm and hands were taken, and her DNA was also tested.
sentences.zh: 拍摄了她的前臂和手部的X光片，还对她的DNA进行了检测。

sentences.en: It was determined that Anichka was between the ages of 13 and 14.
sentences.zh: 经确定，阿尼奇卡的年龄在13至14岁之间。

sentences.en: Armed with a medical certificate confirming Anichka's age, the Maurova sisters applied to Brunei's Municipal Court.
sentences.zh: 毛拉罗娃姐妹拿着确认阿尼奇卡年龄的医疗证明，向布尔诺市法院提出了申请。

sentences.en: They sought a judicial ruling on whether Anichka could remain with Clara and be legally adopted by her.
sentences.zh: 她们寻求法院就阿尼奇卡是否可以留在克拉拉身边并被她合法收养作出裁决。

sentences.en: The hearing was scheduled for March the following year of 2007.
sentences.zh: 听证会定于第二年的2007年3月举行。

sentences.en: As part of the court process, social workers inspected Clara's small flat in Brunei.
sentences.zh: 作为法院审理程序的一部分，社会工作者检查了克拉拉在布尔诺的小公寓。

sentences.en: They found everything to be in order.
sentences.zh: 他们发现一切都符合规定。

sentences.en: By January, Clara had moved her family into a larger, two-storey terraced house on a quiet street in Kurim, 15 kilometres north of Brunei.
sentences.zh: 到1月份时，克拉拉已将她的家人搬到了布尔诺以北15公里处库日姆一条安静街道上一栋更大的两层联排住宅中。

sentences.en: The house was arranged and paid for by Anichka's doctor, Andrei Zanarlov, with the help of Clara's sister, Katerina.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子由阿尼奇卡的医生安德烈·扎纳洛夫在克拉拉的姐姐卡特琳娜的帮助下安排并支付费用。

sentences.en: Clara made sure that Anichka felt at home, painting her room bright yellow and filling it with toys.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉确保阿尼奇卡有宾至如归的感觉，把她的房间漆成明亮的黄色，并塞满了玩具。

sentences.en: Anichka's case was heard in the Municipal Court on March 26.
sentences.zh: 阿尼奇卡的案件于3月26日在市法院开庭审理。

sentences.en: The presiding judge reviewed all the relevant medical and social work documents, as well as some additional reports Katerina had commissioned in support of Clara's application.
sentences.zh: 主审法官审阅了所有相关的医疗和社工文件，以及卡特琳娜为支持克拉拉的申请而委托制作的一些额外报告。

sentences.en: Both sisters provided statements and Anichka was interviewed by the judge.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩都提供了陈述，法官也对阿尼奇卡进行了面谈。

sentences.en: In reaching her decision, the judge concluded that Anichka's biological mother was likely a drug addict who had given birth to Anichka at home.
sentences.zh: 在作出决定时，法官得出结论：阿尼奇卡的亲生母亲可能是一个瘾君子，她在家里生下了阿尼奇卡。

sentences.en: As Anichka had never attended school, it was unlikely there were any formal records in her name.
sentences.zh: 由于阿尼奇卡从未上过学，因此不太可能有任何以她名字登记的正式记录。

sentences.en: The judge granted Anichka the legal birth date of December 2, 1993, making her 13 years, 3 months and 24 days old.
sentences.zh: 法官授予阿尼奇卡的法定出生日期为1993年12月2日，这使她的年龄为13岁3个月24天。

sentences.en: A birth certificate would be created and Anichka finally had legal recognition.
sentences.zh: 将制作出生证明，阿尼奇卡终于获得了法律承认。

sentences.en: Clara's application for adoption was also approved.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉的收养申请也获批准。

sentences.en: Anichka was given Clara's surname, Maurova.
sentences.zh: 阿尼奇卡被冠以克拉拉的姓氏毛拉罗娃。

sentences.en: Six weeks later, on Monday, May 7, 2007, a call was placed to the Kourim police.
sentences.zh: 六周后，即2007年5月7日星期一，库日姆警方接到了一通报警电话。

sentences.en: The caller was a local man named Edouard Trudy.
sentences.zh: 打电话的是当地一名叫爱德华·特鲁迪的男子。

sentences.en: He had been attempting to connect a baby monitor to his television when it intercepted another camera.
sentences.zh: 他当时正试图将婴儿监视器连接到电视上，结果却截获了另一个摄像头。

sentences.en: Its footage showed a naked boy hogtied on a concrete floor.
sentences.zh: 其画面显示一个赤裸的男孩被五花大绑在水泥地上。

sentences.en: Edouard had started recording the live feed to preserve evidence, which he then showed police when they arrived at his house.
sentences.zh: 爱德华开始录制实时画面以保存证据，随后在警察到达他家时向他们展示了这些证据。

sentences.en: Given the operating range of the baby monitor was only about 30 to 50 metres, police believed the boy must be in a neighbouring house.
sentences.zh: 鉴于婴儿监视器的有效工作范围仅约30至50米，警方认为这个男孩一定在邻居家。

sentences.en: As one officer focused on the footage, he recognised a song playing in the background.
sentences.zh: 当一名警官专注于录像时，他认出了背景中播放的一首歌。

sentences.en: Realising that if they knew which house the music was coming from, they might find the boy, the officers turned down the television's audio.
sentences.zh: 意识到如果他们知道音乐来自哪所房子，就可能找到这个男孩，警官们调低了电视的音量。

sentences.en: They then pressed their ears to cups they held against the walls.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们把杯子紧贴在墙上，将耳朵凑上去。

sentences.en: The cups amplified sound, allowing them to hear noises from the houses that shared a wall with Edouard's home.
sentences.zh: 杯子放大了声音，让他们能够听到与爱德华家共用一堵墙的房子里传出的噪音。

sentences.en: Emanating from behind one wall was the same song that was captured in the footage.
sentences.zh: 从一面墙后传出的正是录像中捕捉到的那首歌。

sentences.en: Edouard wasn't familiar with the neighbours on that side and had never seen any boys coming in or out of their house.
sentences.zh: 爱德华对那一侧的邻居并不熟悉，也从未见过有男孩进出他们的房子。

sentences.en: Officers attended the property and two women aged in their 30s answered the front door.
sentences.zh: 警官们前往该物业，两名三十多岁的女性应门。

sentences.en: They refused police requests to enter the premises.
sentences.zh: 她们拒绝了警方进入屋内的请求。

sentences.en: Although the officers didn't have a search warrant, the situation was exceptional.
sentences.zh: 尽管警官们没有搜查令，但情况十分特殊。

sentences.en: Ignoring the women's protests, the police forced their way in and came across a storage cupboard beneath a staircase.
sentences.zh: 无视女人们的抗议，警察强行闯入，发现了一个楼梯底下的储物柜。

sentences.en: It was padlocked.
sentences.zh: 它被挂锁锁上了。

sentences.en: The women insisted that no one was in there, but refused to hand over a key.
sentences.zh: 女人们坚称里面没有人，但拒绝交出钥匙。

sentences.en: They had to be pulled away from the cupboard as police began trying to remove the padlock.
sentences.zh: 当警察开始试图拆除挂锁时，她们不得不被拉离储物柜。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a young girl in pyjamas ran into the room screaming,
sentences.zh: 突然，一个穿着睡衣的小女孩尖叫着跑进房间：

sentences.en: Mama!
sentences.zh: 妈妈！

sentences.en: Mama!
sentences.zh: 妈妈！

sentences.en: After hugging one of the women, the girls started holding onto the officers' legs, hindering their efforts to access the locked cupboard.
sentences.zh: 在拥抱了其中一个女人后，女孩开始抱住警官们的腿，阻碍他们试图接近上锁储物柜的行动。

sentences.en: The padlock was eventually removed and the cupboard opened.
sentences.zh: 挂锁最终被拆除，储物柜被打开。

sentences.en: Inside was a dark room, about two metres by two metres in size.
sentences.zh: 里面是一个大约两米乘两米大小的黑暗房间。

sentences.en: It had no ventilation and an odour of vomit and faeces wafted out.
sentences.zh: 它没有通风设施，飘散出一股呕吐物和粪便的气味。

sentences.en: A bucket sat in one corner.
sentences.zh: 一个水桶放在一个角落里。

sentences.en: There was little else aside from a high-tech security camera that was actively recording the space.
sentences.zh: 除了一个正在积极记录该空间的科技感安全摄像头之外，几乎别无他物。

sentences.en: Next door, Edouard Trudy's eyes were glued to his television.
sentences.zh: 隔壁，爱德华·特鲁迪的眼睛死死盯着电视。

sentences.en: When police had begun knocking at his neighbour's door, the footage of the little boy had abruptly gone dark.
sentences.zh: 当警察开始敲邻居的门时，小男孩的画面突然变黑了。

sentences.en: Someone had suddenly turned off a light within the confined space.
sentences.zh: 有人突然关掉了狭小空间内的一盏灯。

sentences.en: Now that a door had been opened, light filtered back in.
sentences.zh: 现在门被打开了，光线重新透了进来。

sentences.en: Edouard watched live as it illuminated the naked, restrained boy.
sentences.zh: 爱德华现场目睹了光线照亮那个赤裸、被拘束的男孩。

sentences.en: Police scooped him up, removed his restraints and took him to a waiting ambulance.
sentences.zh: 警察将他抱起，解开他的束缚，把他送上了等候的救护车。

sentences.en: The boy's name was Andrei and he was seven years old.
sentences.zh: 男孩名叫安德烈，今年七岁。

sentences.en: He told officers that he was kept in the cupboard under the stairs while his mother, Clara Maurova, and his sister, Anichka Maurova, lived freely in the rest of the house.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，当他的母亲克拉拉·毛拉罗娃和姐姐阿尼奇卡·毛拉罗娃在房子的其余部分自由生活时，他被关在楼梯下的储藏室里。

sentences.en: The other woman at the home when police arrived was Andrei's aunt, Katerina Maurova.
sentences.zh: 警察到达时家里的另一个女人是安德烈的阿姨卡特琳娜·毛拉罗娃。

sentences.en: She visited often.
sentences.zh: 她经常来访。

sentences.en: Neither Clara nor Katerina inquired about Andrei's welfare following his rescue.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉和卡特琳娜在安德烈获救后都没有询问他的健康状况。

sentences.en: Clara Maurova was placed under arrest for child abuse and was remanded in custody as an investigation commenced.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉·毛拉罗娃因虐待儿童被捕，并在调查开始时被还押候审。

sentences.en: Clara's other son, nine-year-old Jakub, wasn't at the family home when police stormed the premises.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉的另一个儿子，九岁的雅库布，在警察突袭该房产时不在家中。

sentences.en: Concerns for his welfare grew, even more so upon the discovery of a locked garden shed in the yard.
sentences.zh: 人们对他的福祉越来越担忧，在院子里发现一个上锁的花园棚后更是如此。

sentences.en: Gaps in its frame were covered by the same type of duct tape that had been used to bind Andrei's hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 其框架上的缝隙被用来捆绑安德烈手脚的同类型强力胶带覆盖着。

sentences.en: The police broke in, but Jakub was not inside.
sentences.zh: 警察破门而入，但里面没有雅库布。

sentences.en: He was soon located and deemed safe.
sentences.zh: 他很快被找到并被认为安然无恙。

sentences.en: As their home life was investigated,
sentences.zh: 随着他们家庭生活的调查展开，

sentences.en: Jakub, Andrei, and Anichka were sent to a children's shelter in Brune run by the Endangered Children Fund.
sentences.zh: 雅库布、安德烈和阿尼奇卡被送往布尔诺由濒危儿童基金会运营的儿童收容所。

sentences.en: During their first day, Anichka remained withdrawn and fearful of social interactions while her brothers played together and appeared to be adjusting.
sentences.zh: 在他们的第一天里，阿尼奇卡仍然孤僻并害怕社交互动，而她的兄弟们则在一起玩耍并且看起来正在适应。

sentences.en: By the following afternoon,
sentences.zh: 到第二天下午，

sentences.en: Andrei began exhibiting post-traumatic stress and high levels of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 安德烈开始表现出创伤后应激障碍和高度焦虑。

sentences.en: He was returned to hospital, where he was stabilised and held for further observation.
sentences.zh: 他被送回医院，在那里病情稳定并被留院进一步观察。

sentences.en: That evening, staff at the shelter commenced their nightly rounds as the children slept.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，当孩子们睡觉时，收容所的工作人员开始了夜间巡视。

sentences.en: They found Jakub sound asleep in the room he shared with Anichka, but her bed was empty.
sentences.zh: 他们发现雅库布在和阿尼奇卡共用的房间里熟睡，但她的床是空的。

sentences.en: A search of the facility failed to locate her.
sentences.zh: 对设施的搜查未能找到她。

sentences.en: It was soon realised that one of the windows in Anichka's room was open.
sentences.zh: 人们很快意识到阿尼奇卡房间的一扇窗户开着。

sentences.en: It was not possible for a child to open the window on their own.
sentences.zh: 儿童无法自己打开窗户。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《罪案档案》继续制作优质内容。

sentences.en: Hundreds of police officers searched for Anichka Maurova.
sentences.zh: 数百名警察搜寻了阿妮奇卡·毛罗娃。

sentences.en: She was known to feel comfortable in the wilderness, so a helicopter with heat-seeking capabilities scoured nearby wooded areas.
sentences.zh: 据称她习惯在野外活动，因此一架配备热成像仪的直升机对附近的树林进行了搜查。

sentences.en: A spokesperson for the children's shelter publicly voiced concern that Anichka had been kidnapped and said they were worried about her fragile health.
sentences.zh: 儿童庇护所的一名发言人公开表达担忧，称阿妮奇卡可能遭到绑架，并表示对她脆弱的健康状况感到忧虑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, with his brother hospitalised and sister missing, nine-year-old Jakub remained at the children's shelter alone.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，随着哥哥住院、妹妹失踪，九岁的雅库布独自留在了儿童庇护所。

sentences.en: None of his relatives were permitted to visit him, so he was mostly left to his own devices.
sentences.zh: 他的亲属无一人获准探视，因此他基本上处于无人照管的状态。

sentences.en: As he watched television one day,
sentences.zh: 一天，当他在看电视时，

sentences.en: Jakub saw the footage of his brother's imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 雅库布看到了他哥哥被禁锢的画面。

sentences.en: It had been leaked to the media, along with a statement André gave police that detailed his ordeal.
sentences.zh: 这些画面连同安德烈向警方提供的详细陈述其遭遇的供词一起，被泄露给了媒体。

sentences.en: In his statement, André said he'd been abused for a long time in a number of locations and by more people than just his mother.
sentences.zh: 安德烈在供词中称，自己在多个地点长期遭到虐待，施暴者不仅有他的母亲，还有其他人。

sentences.en: Eventually, Jakub revealed to police that he too had been treated the same way.
sentences.zh: 最终，雅库布向警方透露，他自己也曾遭受过同样的对待。

sentences.en: It all began shortly after Anichka was brought into their home in the autumn of 2005.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于2005年秋天，阿妮奇卡被带到他们家后不久。

sentences.en: Clara Maurova cared for Anichka on the instruction and guidance of Anichka's doctor,
sentences.zh: 克拉拉·毛罗娃在阿妮奇卡医生的指示和指导下照顾阿妮奇卡，

sentences.en: Andrey Zanarlov.
sentences.zh: 这位医生是安德烈·扎纳尔洛夫。

sentences.en: He said that in order for Anichka to heal from her past trauma, she would need to feel completely safe and welcome in Clara's home.
sentences.zh: 他表示，为了让阿妮奇卡从过去的创伤中恢复，她需要在克拉拉的家里感受到完全的安全和欢迎。

sentences.en: Clara had to lavish Anichka with attention, praise and reassurance.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉必须对阿妮奇卡给予大量的关注、表扬和安慰。

sentences.en: Dr Zanarlov also diagnosed Anichka with a condition that caused spinal fluid to build up, but could be treated with massage therapy.
sentences.zh: 扎纳尔洛夫医生还诊断阿妮奇卡患有一种导致脊髓液积聚的疾病，但可以通过按摩疗法治疗。

sentences.en: Clara was instructed to regularly massage Anichka's entire body.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉被指示定期为阿妮奇卡进行全身按摩。

sentences.en: The doctor explained that massaging Anichka's intimate areas would also desensitise and reprogram her past sexual trauma.
sentences.zh: 医生解释说，按摩阿妮奇卡的隐私部位还能使她对过去的性创伤脱敏并重新建立认知。

sentences.en: Over time, Anichka began to improve.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，阿妮奇卡的情况开始好转。

sentences.en: But Clara's efforts to help the young girl had become an obsession.
sentences.zh: 但克拉拉帮助这个年轻女孩的努力已经变成了一种执念。

sentences.en: She began neglecting her sons, often sending them to stay with their grandparents.
sentences.zh: 她开始疏于照顾自己的儿子们，经常把他们送到祖父母家寄住。

sentences.en: By the summer of 2006,
sentences.zh: 到2006年夏天，

sentences.en: Clara had been trying to adopt Anichka without success for almost nine months.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉尝试收养阿妮奇卡已近九个月，却迟迟没有成功。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dr Zanarlov was growing concerned about the family's situation.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，扎纳尔洛夫医生开始对这家人的情况感到担忧。

sentences.en: Anichka had told him that Andrey and Jakub were being mean to her and he felt that she would never truly be a part of the family if they didn't accept her.
sentences.zh: 阿妮奇卡曾告诉他，安德烈和雅库布对她很不好，他觉得如果他们不接纳她，她就永远无法真正融入这个家庭。

sentences.en: He recommended that Clara use corporal punishment against her sons to make them behave.
sentences.zh: 他建议克拉拉对儿子们实施体罚以规范他们的行为。

sentences.en: Starting in July 2006,
sentences.zh: 从2006年7月开始，

sentences.en: Clara dutifully began to beat Andrey and Jakub with a wooden spoon and a metal belt buckle.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉尽职尽责地开始用木勺和金属皮带扣殴打安德烈和雅库布。

sentences.en: The boys were also made to kneel for hours at a time or else be locked in a cupboard with no food, water or toilet access.
sentences.zh: 男孩们还被迫连续跪上几个小时，否则就会被关进一个没有食物、水或厕所的碗柜里。

sentences.en: At night, they had to sleep on a mat on the floor.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，他们必须睡在地板上的垫子上。

sentences.en: They were completely isolated from family and friends.
sentences.zh: 他们与家人和朋友完全隔绝。

sentences.en: This abuse continued for around five weeks.
sentences.zh: 这种虐待持续了大约五个星期。

sentences.en: Then, Dr Zanarlov advised Clara to bring the boys to a cottage in Vyverska-Betishka, a town about 20 kilometres northwest of Brunet.
sentences.zh: 随后，扎纳尔洛夫医生建议克拉拉把男孩们带到维韦尔斯卡-贝蒂什卡的一处乡间小屋，那是一个距离布鲁内特西北约20公里的城镇。

sentences.en: There, the re-education would begin.
sentences.zh: 在那里，再教育将正式开始。

sentences.en: Andrey and Jakub arrived at the cottage in late August 2006.
sentences.zh: 安德烈和雅库布于2006年8月下旬抵达小屋。

sentences.en: It was an isolated property at the end of a small country lane on the outskirts of town.
sentences.zh: 这是一处偏僻的房产，位于城镇边缘一条乡村小路尽头。

sentences.en: Trees concealed the residence from view.
sentences.zh: 树木将这处住所遮挡得严严实实。

sentences.en: The boys' aunt, Katerina Maurova, was already there when they arrived.
sentences.zh: 男孩们的姑姑卡特琳娜·毛罗娃在他们到达时已经在那儿了。

sentences.en: She'd brought with her two dog cages, one for each brother.
sentences.zh: 她带来了两个狗笼，两兄弟一人一个。

sentences.en: They were locked in the cages, which forced them to remain bent or kneeling and unable to move.
sentences.zh: 他们被锁在笼子里，这迫使他们只能弯腰或跪着，无法动弹。

sentences.en: They were only fed scraps of food and were not released to use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他们只被喂食残羹冷炙，上厕所也不得被放出来。

sentences.en: If they tried to communicate with one another, they were beaten.
sentences.zh: 如果他们试图互相交流，就会遭到毒打。

sentences.en: That night, the first re-education session began.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，第一场再教育课程开始了。

sentences.en: The boys were bound, blindfolded, and beaten.
sentences.zh: 男孩们被捆绑、蒙上双眼并遭到殴打。

sentences.en: Clara scratched and stabbed her sons with a fork and forced their heads underwater while Katerina held them in place.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉用叉子抓伤、刺伤儿子们的身体，并在卡特琳娜按住他们身体的同时将他们的头按入水中。

sentences.en: Andre and Jakub had to memorise vulgar passages and were hurt if they failed to recount them word for word.
sentences.zh: 安德烈和雅库布必须背诵粗俗的段落，如果无法逐字背出就会受到惩罚。

sentences.en: The torture continued into the next day.
sentences.zh: 折磨一直持续到第二天。

sentences.en: As well as being victimised,
sentences.zh: 在遭受虐待的同时，

sentences.en: Andre was also made to hurt his brother.
sentences.zh: 安德烈还被迫伤害自己的弟弟。

sentences.en: But when Anichka accused Andre of physically harming her, he bore the brunt of the abuse.
sentences.zh: 但当阿妮奇卡指控安德烈对她进行身体伤害时，他便承受了最猛烈的虐待。

sentences.en: At one point, Anichka even joined in.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，阿妮奇卡甚至也加入了施暴行列。

sentences.en: While Dr. Andrei Zinalov wasn't present at the cottage, he kept in touch with Clara via text messages and emails.
sentences.zh: 虽然安德烈·齐纳洛夫医生当时不在小屋，但他通过短信和电子邮件与克拉拉保持联系。

sentences.en: When Clara informed him that Andre's re-education was not working,
sentences.zh: 当克拉拉告知他安德烈的再教育没有起作用时，

sentences.en: Dr. Zinalov devised a plan.
sentences.zh: 齐纳洛夫医生制定了一个计划。

sentences.en: As per the doctor's orders,
sentences.zh: 按照医生的吩咐，

sentences.en: Clara handed Andre a glass of water and told him to give it to Jakub, who was thirsty.
sentences.zh: 克拉拉递给安德烈一杯水，让他拿给口渴的雅库布。

sentences.en: Andre did as instructed and Jakub drank from the glass.
sentences.zh: 安德烈照做了，雅库布喝下了这杯水。

sentences.en: He was then taken away.
sentences.zh: 随后他被带走了。

sentences.en: Andre was then informed that the water he had just given his older brother was actually poison.
sentences.zh: 接着安德烈被告知，他刚给哥哥喝的水其实是有毒的。

sentences.en: He was led outside to the back of the cottage where Jakub's lifeless body lay in a freshly dug grave.
sentences.zh: 他被带到小屋后方的室外，那里有一个新挖的墓穴，雅库布没有生气的尸体正躺在里面。

sentences.en: Andre was told that if he behaved himself and obeyed all instructions, then Jakub would come back to life.
sentences.zh: 安德烈被告知，如果他听话并服从所有指令，雅库布就会复活。

sentences.en: Andre promised to be good and Jakub, who'd been forced to play dead by the adults, got up.
sentences.zh: 安德烈答应做一个听话的孩子，而一直被大人强迫装死的雅库布站了起来。

sentences.en: Dr. Zinalov reassured Clara that these re-education practices were scientifically proven to be effective in modifying bad behaviour and insisted that the program
sentences.zh: 齐纳洛夫医生向克拉拉保证，这些再教育手段已被科学证明对矫正不良行为有效，并坚持宣称这一计划

sentences.en: was nearly complete.
sentences.zh: 已经接近完成。

sentences.en: His next demand was for Clara to burn Andre's buttocks, cut off a piece of the wounded flesh, and forced the young boy to eat it.
sentences.zh: 他的下一个要求是让克拉拉烧灼安德烈的臀部，割下一块受伤的肉，并强迫这个小男孩吃下去。

sentences.en: This was too far for Clara, who couldn't carry out the order.
sentences.zh: 这超出了克拉拉的底线，她无法执行这个命令。

sentences.en: Disappointed in her,
sentences.zh: 对她感到失望，

sentences.en: Dr. Zinalov decided to send out reinforcements.
sentences.zh: 齐纳洛夫医生决定派出增援。

sentences.en: Two men and a woman soon arrived at the cottage.
sentences.zh: 两名男子和一名女子很快抵达了小屋。

sentences.en: 29-year-old Jan Turek was a scout leader at Katerina Mauerova's
sentences.zh: 29岁的扬·图雷克是卡特琳娜·莫伊索娃旗下的

sentences.en: Centre for Children.
sentences.zh: 儿童中心的童军领袖。

sentences.en: His friend,
sentences.zh: 他的朋友，
